visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and a black jacket stands in a busy night market at night. He holds a scallion pancake in a paper bag, taking a large bite while looking directly into the camera lens with a satisfied expression. The background is filled with glowing yellow stall signs and blurry figures of other shoppers. (2) The man is seen outdoors at night, holding a yellow bottled juice with Chinese characters on the label. He sips the drink while looking off-camera. The lighting is low with artificial street lamps creating a warm, slightly grainy atmosphere. (3) Indoors in a modern, brightly lit restaurant, the man uses black chopsticks to lift noodles from a pink plate. He smiles at the camera, showing his teeth. Other diners are seated at wooden tables in the background. (4) Standing outside a storefront with blue and white signage, the man wears black-rimmed glasses and sips a beverage through a straw from a cup with a colorful graphic. The camera is positioned at a medium close-up, focusing on his face and the drink. (5) Inside another restaurant, the man holds a large white spoon and prepares to eat a soup dumpling. His mouth is wide open in an exaggerated, excited expression. The interior features warm wood paneling. (6) At a hot pot restaurant, the man uses chopsticks to stir ingredients in a boiling white soup base. White heart-shaped emojis float across the screen around his head. He looks down at the food, nodding with pleasure. (7) A close-up shot of the man's face as he chews his food and smiles warmly. The lighting is soft and flat, suggesting a comfortable indoor environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks the introductory phrase "I like to eat" with a friendly, casual cadence. Immediately, a bright electronic percussion track with a strong, 120 BPM kick drum begins. (2) A sharp, synthesized impact sound or digital beep marks the first visual transition. The background music settles into a rhythmic loop characterized by a punchy bass and a repeated vocal sample on every second beat, synced perfectly with the montage cuts. (3) The electronic beat continues with high spectral brightness and clarity. Ambient restaurant noise and street chatter are present at a very low intensity, heavily masked by the dominant, high-energy music layer. (4) The track maintains a consistent percussive intensity throughout the series of rapid-fire cuts. A final rhythmic beat concludes the audio sequence, leaving a lingering upbeat and energetic impression.
